settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language, currency, theme, mascot, and local data preferences
settings.privacy_title: 100% Local-First • Zero Telemetry • Zero External Servers
settings.language_subtitle: 100% bilingual parity across Portuguese and English
settings.currency_subtitle: Primary currency used for rollups, budget envelopes and metrics
settings.theme_subtitle: Perceptually uniform OKLCH color space with WCAG AAA contrast
settings.theme_dark_desc: Deep slate with a green glow
settings.mascot_subtitle: Customize your fortune frog nickname and control screen roaming
settings.roaming_desc: Allows Keroo to hop across cards and perch on borders
settings.data_subtitle: Toggle between realistic demonstration data and a clean slate
settings.demo_desc: Fills the database with checking accounts, credit cards with 1x-24x installments, upcoming bills and piggy banks with progress so you can try the full app.
settings.reset_desc: Deletes all entries and zeroes the accounts, keeping the essential categories configured with zero balances. Perfect for real personal finance use.
settings.privacy_desc: Keroo runs entirely on your browser's IndexedDB storage. Your balances, bank statements, card purchases and split expenses are never sent to external servers, analytics or cloud AI.
settings.demo_modal_subtitle: This will replace the current database with simulated data
settings.demo_modal_desc: This operation will erase the current data and insert a complete set of sample accounts, installment purchases, bills and piggy banks for visual testing.
settings.reset_modal_warning: Warning: all statements, installments and splits will be deleted. The database will return to its clean initial state with zero balances.
settings.err_generic: Something went wrong. Your data was not changed. Please try again.
settings.backup_desc: Keroo lives only in this browser. Clearing site data or switching browsers erases everything, so export a backup file regularly and keep it somewhere safe.
settings.backup_exported: Backup file exported. Keep it somewhere safe.
settings.backup_confirm_desc: This REPLACES all current data in this browser with the contents of the file. Anything not in the backup will be lost.
settings.backup_err_INVALID_JSON: This file is not valid JSON. Choose a backup exported by Keroo.
settings.backup_err_UNKNOWN_FORMAT: This file is not a Keroo backup.
settings.backup_err_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION: This backup was made by a newer or unknown version of Keroo and cannot be restored here.
settings.backup_err_MALFORMED_TABLES: This backup is damaged: its data tables are malformed.
settings.backup_err_GENERIC: Could not restore the backup. Your current data was not changed.
settings.backup_storage_usage: Storage used on this device: {used} MB of {quota} MB available
settings.lock_desc: Ask for a password every time Keroo opens, and after 10 minutes without use.
settings.lock_note: The password keeps other people out of Keroo in this browser. It does not encrypt your data, and Keroo cannot recover a forgotten password, so keep a recent backup.
settings.lock_err_mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
settings.lock_err_unavailable: This browser blocks the lock on this address. Open Keroo on localhost or over HTTPS.
settings.lock_enabled_msg: The lock is on. Keroo will ask for the password the next time it opens.

lock.erase_error: Could not erase the data. Close other Keroo windows and try again.
